subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 10: Quarter Circle Graphing Task
description: Design a coordinate-plane logo using circles, then justify each circle with its center, radius, equation, and graph.
learningObjectives: Design a coordinate-plane logo using at least three circles
Write center-radius equations for circles in a design
Identify centers, radii, and squared radii from circle equations
Connect equations, graphs, and coordinate conditions
Check whether a proposed logo circle matches its equation and points
prerequisites: Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
Identifying center and radius from center-radius form
Writing circle equations from a center and radius
Expanding and simplifying simple squared binomials
Checking whether a point satisfies an equation
